result.brief: 提出融合持续同调的拓扑感知掩码自编码表征学习框架，通过拓扑引导掩码与辅助同调解码器编码全局结构连通性，提升TPMS超材料的分类、聚类与回归性能。
result.reason: Proposes topology-aware masked autoencoder representation learning with persistent-homology-guided masking and auxiliary decoder, evaluated via linear probe and clustering—a genuine visual/3D representation contribution.
